verdict.rationale: BILL's pricing page documents automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks Enterprise and Oracle NetSuite, and the S&E product page says every transaction is 'categorized'. Nothing ties that sync specifically to Spend & Expense card transactions, and nothing shows user-controlled GL account, class, or department mapping. Missing for 10: evidence the sync covers S&E card transactions, Xero support, user-controlled GL/class/department mapping configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
